svg.aria-label: dsh-store-replenish structure: one 10-column store-SKU CSV row is measured on a stock-level gauge (target stock, available stock, gap), the gap is packed along a MOQ ladder into a suggested quantity, rows roll up into per-store plans ranked by stockout risk, and replenish.export writes a fixed 13-column CSV under DSH_HOME
svg.title: dsh-store-replenish: gauge, MOQ ladder, store roll-up, 13-column CSV
svg.text: one store-SKU CSV · a gauge per row · MOQ ladder · per-store roll-up · 13-column CSV
default: suggested_qty > 0 only · include_zero=true appends the rest
slow_moving ← turnover > 60 d · stockout_risk ← available < daily × cycle_days · stockout_now ← stock = 0 & daily > 0
R0 read-only · R1 local write · source CSV never modified · no network · integer units / integer cents
